measurementWorkspace.title: Your progress, in perspective
measurementWorkspace.subtitle: Bring your readings together. Understand what is changing, and how your training fits in.

summary.title: Summary
summary.hint: Read the story of your progress.

trends.title: Trends
trends.hint: Choose a measurement, source and period.

history.title: History
history.hint: Browse your saved readings, a page at a time.

measurementWorkspace.chooseSection: Choose what you would like to explore. Your measurements load when you select a view.
measurementWorkspace.chooseTrend: Choose a measurement and its source to load a trend.
measurementWorkspace.legacyOrder: Older reports follow their saved record date; each reading keeps its original measurement date.
measurementWorkspace.historyScanning: This page of older records has no measurements. Continue to the next page to keep exploring.
measurementWorkspace.empty: Your first reading is a starting point
measurementWorkspace.emptyHint: Enter a few measurements or import a report from your scale. You can add more details whenever you like.
measurementWorkspace.reviewHint: Check the date, source, units and readings before they enter your history.
measurementWorkspace.previousReadingHint: Previous readings are references only. Enter new values and leave anything you have not measured blank.
measurementWorkspace.previousReadingError: Previous readings could not be loaded.
measurementWorkspace.previousReadingIncomplete: Older records are outside this reference search. Some previous readings may be unavailable.
measurementWorkspace.label: Measurement
measurementWorkspace.imageHint: Your original picture is kept with the saved readings.
measurementWorkspace.sourceHint: Keep a consistent source and method: your tape for home measurements, the clinic or report name for anthropometry, or Fitdays with BIA. Different methods stay separate.
measurementWorkspace.lowConfidence: Check this reading against the original
measurementWorkspace.fileHint: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP · up to 10 MB · PDFs up to 20 pages
measurementWorkspace.textHint: Paste the original report text, including its date and units. Different scale formats are welcome.
measurementWorkspace.textExample:
2026-10-17
Weight: 78.2 kg
Body fat: 19.4 %
Waist: 81 cm
measurementWorkspace.dateMissing: Confirm a valid measurement date for every reading.
measurementWorkspace.invalid: Give each reading a source and at least one valid measurement. Values must be numbers, with clear labels and units.
measurementWorkspace.fileInvalid: Choose a PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP file up to 10 MB.
measurementWorkspace.error: We could not complete that action. Your saved measurements are safe. Please try again.
measurementWorkspace.loadError: Your measurements could not be loaded.
measurementWorkspace.insights: What your progress is telling you
measurementWorkspace.preparing: Your readings are saved. Preparing a fresh progress summary…
measurementWorkspace.failed: Your measurements are saved, but the analysis could not finish.
measurementWorkspace.noInsight: Save a reading or request an analysis to connect your measurements and training history.
measurementWorkspace.memoryHint: A summary built from your readings and training. It is refreshed when the underlying data changes.
measurementWorkspace.comparability: Comparisons keep each source and measurement method separate. Same-day repeats use their median. A change of scale can affect the reading.
measurementWorkspace.historicalReportHint: Historical reference: {{sources}}. No further readings are expected. Current advice and targets use your own tracking and training.
measurementWorkspace.noTrend: Add a comparable reading from another day to see a trend.
measurementWorkspace.dailyMedian: When there are several readings on one day, the chart uses their median.
measurementWorkspace.deleteHint: This removes the reading and invalidates summaries that use it. Your other readings and workouts remain available.
measurementWorkspace.more: Showing the newest 500 observations. Older source records are outside this view.
measurementWorkspace.demo: Demo insights are simulated locally. Your files and measurements stay in this browser.
measurementWorkspace.stale: Your readings or workouts changed. Refresh the analysis to use the latest data.
measurementWorkspace.dateUnknownHint: Keep the date blank if the report does not specify it. Undated readings stay out of time trends.
measurementWorkspace.uploadingHint: Sending your original file. The reading step starts when the upload finishes.
measurementWorkspace.readingHint: Reading the report’s date, units and measurements.
measurementWorkspace.uploadSlow: The upload is taking longer than usual. Keep this window open and check your connection.
measurementWorkspace.readingSlow: Still reading. Some reports take a few minutes. Keep this window open; your measurements are not saved yet.
measurementWorkspace.uploadFailed: Your file could not be uploaded. Check your connection and try again. The selected picture is still here.
measurementWorkspace.extractionFailed: We could not read the report. Try again with the same file, or choose a clearer picture. No new measurements were saved.
measurementWorkspace.importTimeout: Reading took too long. Try again with the same file; the results may already be ready. No new measurements were saved.
measurementWorkspace.uploadTimeout: The upload timed out. Check your connection and try again with the selected file.
measurementWorkspace.importPermission: Your session or file access could not be verified. Sign in again, then retry the upload.
measurementWorkspace.noExtractedReadings: No measurements were found. Choose a clearer picture showing the readings, date and units, or enter them manually.
measurementWorkspace.saveReportHint: Fitdays and other smart-scale reports are welcome. Your readings and original file will be saved. You can edit them afterward.
measurementWorkspace.savingReportHint: Saving the readings and original file to your history.
measurementWorkspace.reportSaved: Report saved. You can view or edit the readings in your history.
measurementWorkspace.importSaveFailed: Your report was read, but saving did not finish. Retry saving; you do not need to upload or read it again.
measurementWorkspace.importNeedsEdit: One reading needs a correction before it can be saved. You can edit it below.

progressStatement.title: Your progress update
progressStatement.preparing: Saved. Preparing your short progress review…
progressStatement.failed: Your readings are saved. Coaching could not finish; you can retry it.
progressStatement.loadFailed: Your readings are saved, but the progress statement could not be loaded.
progressStatement.stale: Your records changed. Open the full analysis to review the latest progress.
progressStatement.undated: This report has no measurement date, so a change over time cannot be established.
progressStatement.baseline: No comparable change is available for this report yet. These readings are a baseline, not proof of a trend.
progressStatement.addDate: Add the report’s measurement date, then compare readings from the same scale and method.
progressStatement.nextReading: Record your next workouts and repeat measurements with the same scale and conditions before adjusting your plan.
progressStatement.dailyMedians: Same source and method · daily medians
